verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's docs and product design directly support prompt-to-full-stack-app creation (natural-language building, Supabase backend, Stripe payments, one-click deploy/hosting), and community reports confirm users going from idea to working prod app in hours (bolt-comm-3, bolt-comm-4, bolt-comm-5). However, other hands-on reports describe doom-loop breakage cycles and destructive unauthorized AI edits that undermine reliability of the generated app (bolt-comm-9, bolt-comm-7), and one critique argues outsourcing the backend to Supabase caps how 'full-stack' the result really is (bolt-comm-11). Missing for 10: independent benchmark of end-to-end reliability across many app types, and resolution of the destructive-edit/doom-loop complaints.
